questions.prompt: Plain pi passes 12 of 20 tasks. The pack passes 18 of 20. What is the lift?
questions.explanation: 12 of 20 is 60%. 18 of 20 is 90%. The lift is 90% minus 60%, which is 30 percentage points.

questions.prompt: Both arms pass 19 of 20 tasks. What does this tell you?
options: The tasks are too easy to tell the arms apart, so you should add harder ones
questions.explanation: Both arms pass 95%, so the lift is 0. The tasks are saturated: they cannot show whether the pack helps.

questions.prompt: Why does the control run use the same model and the same fixture?
options: So the only difference between the arms is the pack
So the control passes more tasks
So the runner needs only one folder
questions.explanation: If anything else changed, you could not say that the pack caused the difference in pass rate.
